read.title: Delay in Product Launch
read.text:
Dear Ms. Carter,

I regret to inform you that the launch of our Vitamin Glow Serum will be delayed by about three weeks. Due to an unforeseen problem with a key ingredient supplier, our production is currently behind schedule.

The revised launch date is January 15. We have already secured a new supplier, and our quality team is running final tests this week. We will notify you immediately if there are any further changes.

To make up for this setback, we would like to offer your stores a 5% discount on the first order. Our sales team will contact you to discuss the details.

We appreciate your patience and understanding.

Sincerely,
Minsu Park

write.en: Write a short email to your manager explaining that your market report will be two days late, with the reason and the new date.
hints: I regret to inform you that
write.model:
Hi Mr. Lee,

I regret to inform you that the market report will be two days late. Due to a delay in receiving the sales data from our U.S. partner, I couldn't finish the analysis on time. I will submit it by Thursday noon. I appreciate your patience.

Best regards,
Minsu
